lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap, a crowdsourced geographic database maintained by volunteer contributors. The dataset represents approximately 60% of total buildings based on AI-mapped estimates, with an average data age of 6 years and last updates 3 months prior to export. Data is provided in multiple vector formats (SHP, KML, GeoJSON, GeoPackage) for spatial analysis and risk assessment applications.
